about: The motion library: Mixamo clips on our rig (Assets/MusicVideo/Motion/Humanoid@mx_*.fbx), each watched at real speed through `mv lab` renders (front and three-quarter, 30 fps) and stepped frame by frame. Written by hand after watching; `node Director/tools/motion_lib.mjs gallery` turns it into gallery.md. Times are clip seconds at speed 1. `speed140`/`speed100` put the clip's own pulse on the beat at those tempos (beat 0.4286 s / 0.6 s). `masks` are the layer masks worth taking. Verdict A build on it, B a moment or a masked part, C don't use.

mx_point_bent.watched: front and three-quarter, every frame at 15 fps
mx_point_bent.style: A bent-arm point at the lens, right hand, elbow stays bent, no weight shift

segments.use: the point on a lyric; cut at 2.1 to hold it

mx_point_bent.good: right arm and the small head lift

mx_thankful.watched: front and three-quarter, every frame at 15 fps
mx_thankful.style: Right hand to the heart, a bow of the head, a second of holding it, release

segments.use: hand on heart

mx_thankful.good: right arm, head, a little chest

mx_blow_kiss.watched: front and three-quarter, every frame at 15 fps
mx_blow_kiss.style: Hand to the lips, a kiss blown out to the side, arm opens, drops

segments.use: finger to lips, shh, with the hand shut to one finger
blow a kiss

mx_blow_kiss.good: right arm and head; the arm opens wide at 2.6-3.0 so cut before that for a small moment
mx_blow_kiss.avoid: the open-arm end if arms must stay in

mx_sigh.watched: front and three-quarter, every frame at 15 fps
mx_sigh.style: Shoulders rise and drop, a small head turn; barely reads from the front

segments.use: an additive upper layer under a sung line

mx_sigh.avoid: as a whole-body cue; too small

mx_thinking.watched: front and three-quarter, every frame at 15 fps
mx_thinking.style: Right hand to the chin and cheek, head tilts into it, holds, releases

segments.what: hand to chin 0.9-1.1, hold to 2.8, release
segments.use: hand to cheek, thinking, coy

mx_secret.watched: front and three-quarter, every frame at 15 fps
mx_secret.style: Leans in with a cupped hand at the mouth, as if whispering, for six seconds, then back

segments.what: lean in and hand to mouth
segments.use: a whispered line; the lean is big, shoot front-on

mx_secret.good: right arm and the lean of the spine
mx_secret.avoid: the long hold past 3 s; the lean reads as leaning on something

mx_wave.watched: front and three-quarter, every frame at 15 fps
mx_wave.style: Half a second of a wave; too short to read, two pops
mx_wave.good: nothing a longer wave does not do better

mx_wave_aj.watched: front and three-quarter, every frame at 15 fps
mx_wave_aj.style: A big quick hello wave with the shoulders in it, 1.5 s

segments.use: wave to the lens

mx_greeting.watched: front and three-quarter, every frame at 15 fps
mx_greeting.style: Right hand rises open beside the head and holds there, a hello or a hand through the hair

segments.what: hand up 1.3-1.7, held at head height to 3.4, drops
segments.use: hello; at speed 1.5 from 1.2 s it is the nearest thing to a hair flick

mx_bow_formal.good: spine and head; the legs do nothing

mx_head_no.watched: front and three-quarter, every frame at 15 fps

mx_nod.watched: front and three-quarter, every frame at 15 fps

mx_excited.avoid: the legs; he turns away about 2 s

mx_hh_timid.avoid: as a chorus: nothing happens above the waist

mx_house_4.watched: front and three-quarter at 15 fps, the first 7 s

segments.use: legs only under a tighter upper body; he turns to profile

mx_house_4.avoid: the arms past 4 s (wide) and the whole body facing off front

mx_samba_pocoto.avoid: arms 0-2 s (wide) and the throws after 5 s

mx_salsa_f.watched: front and three-quarter, every frame at 15 fps

mx_twist.watched: front and three-quarter at 15 fps, the first 7 s
mx_twist.style: The twist: knees together, hips twisting, arms pumping low at the waist; a lean-back with one arm up in the middle

loop with the first
a pose on a hit, B

mx_twist.avoid: the lean back unless it is the point
